text.en: When the canals are strong, water rises, then paddy rises, then the people prosper.

Periyapuranam, composed by Sekkizhar, is the twelfth Thirumurai and tells the lives of the sixty-three Nayanmars. The textbook poem describes the Chola country as a land of water, where the river Kaveri spreads flowers and fertility along its path.
It conveys the saying that when the bunds rise the water rises, when the water rises the paddy rises, and when the paddy rises the people rise. This is the chain of prosperity in a farming country.
Learn the terms புராணம் (epic-like sacred story), நாயன்மார் (Shaiva saints), திருமுறை (sacred Shaiva collection), காவிரி (river Kaveri) and சோழநாடு (Chola country). It is a memorisation poem.
